description: A school principal must approve the operating and privacy plan for an eighth-grade oral-history project, including the student interviewer roster, publication permissions, recording equipment, storage, retention, and required documentation, with input from the project teacher, school counselor, and instructional technology coordinator.

shared_context.S1: An eighth-grade civics class has proposed an oral-history project in which students interview 20 community members identified as I1 through I20 about local history.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan calls for all 20 students J1 through J20 to conduct interviews, audio recording on personal phones, publication of all 20 recordings on the public school website, and indefinite retention of the files.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan must approve the project before interviews begin.
shared_context.S4: District policy requires the approval packet to include current findings from the project advisor, school counselor, and instructional technology coordinator about student eligibility, consent, recording technology, storage, and retention.
shared_context.S5: As a routine approval step, Dr. Morgan calls on the project advisor, school counselor, and instructional technology coordinator in turn for their complete findings; after all three reports are given, Dr. Morgan records the approval decision and required plan changes before any further discussion.

PF1.text: Ms. Patel's roster review shows that exactly eight students have completed the district's media-ethics training: J1, J3, J6, J8, J11, J14, J17, and J20. Only those eight may conduct recorded interviews, and the approval file must include a training-verification record.

PF2.text: Mr. Lewis's family-consent review confirms that interviewees I2, I5, I9, I14, and I18 have not granted permission for public web publication. Their recordings may be used only in the school's internal archive. The other 15 interviewees may be included in public publication, and the plan must include a consent-exclusion record.

PF3.text: Ms. Romero's technology review confirms that personal phones cannot be used for school recordings. The project must use district tablets, store source files in the restricted OralHistory drive, and delete recordings exactly 45 days after the final class presentation. The technology plan must include a secure-storage configuration record.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly the eight trained students must be approved as interviewers.
A training-verification record must be included.
Exactly the 15 consented interviews must be approved for public publication.
Exactly I2, I5, I9, I14, and I18 must be excluded from public publication.
A consent-exclusion record must be included.
District tablets must be used and source files must be stored in the restricted OralHistory drive.
Recordings must be deleted exactly 45 days after the final presentation.
A secure-storage configuration record must be included.

content_checks.C2: any('training-verification record' in c['type'] or 'training-verification record' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('consent-exclusion record' in c['type'] or 'consent-exclusion record' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['recording_equipment'] == 'district tablets' and decisions['storage_location'] == 'restricted OralHistory drive'
content_checks.C8: any('secure-storage configuration record' in c['type'] or 'secure-storage configuration record' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The roster review changes the approved interviewer list from all 20 students to exactly J1, J3, J6, J8, J11, J14, J17, and J20 and adds the required training-verification record.
The consent review changes the public list to exactly the 15 consented interview IDs, excludes exactly I2, I5, I9, I14, and I18, and adds the required consent-exclusion record.

The technology review changes the equipment to district tablets, the storage location to the restricted OralHistory drive, the deletion deadline to exactly 45 days, and adds the required secure-storage configuration record.
